explanation: The selected plan's file map omits the documentation of the exact attribution contract this issue changes. docs/analytics.md (Exact attribution, lines 483-493) states that when overlapping windows share one vendor sessionId/turnId the most recently started action receives the record as an explicitly partial shared-turn fallback, and that turn-keyed records mapping to multiple actions use the same rule. After the planned change, shared-turn records whose timestamps fall in exactly one action slice are attributed exactly and coverage can be complete, so the shipped doc would contradict the shipped behaviour. All three plan reviews (muse, claude, codex) flagged this omission. The implementation in the approved four files is finished and passes focused tests; only this paragraph remains.

additionalPaths.reason: Rewrite only the Codex shared-turn sentences in the Exact attribution section so they describe the issue's required behaviour: each shared-turn record is attributed to the action whose slice (its prompt up to the next sibling prompt, never past its own stop; an unstopped last action bounded by its phase) contains the record's timestamp, and only records with no timestamp, outside every slice, or tied across phases keep the latest-action partial fallback. No other documentation changes.
